title: Callum Turner's new film sparkles at Dinard Film Festival
summary: British and Irish cinema have been in the spotlight at the Breton resort of Dinard for more than three decades, with films like "The Full Monty" and "Billy Elliot" getting their starts at the town's annual film festival.
